title: Compact long conversations while preserving constraints and open work
description: Acceptance criteria from MAST-31 that remain open: a long conversation stays inside a configured budget; compaction preserves constraints and unresolved work.
why: Split from MAST-31: long chat history must stay inside a budget without losing constraints or unresolved work.

acceptance.text: Long conversation stays inside a configured budget
Compaction preserves constraints and unresolved work

outcome.summary: Configured a 6,000-token conversation history budget with 1,500-token trimming, a 20-message cap, and bounded thread-scoped working memory; added a default 2,048-token model output limit for Studio and direct calls.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check; node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/context/conversation-budget.test.mjs (1/1 passed), checking memory budget/schema plus Studio, generate, and stream output defaults. No live model request was made.
